# TAM HTTP API

*Generated by `tools/gen_api_docs.py` — do not edit by hand.*

42 endpoints. Base URL is `http://<db_host>:8787`; on this cluster that is the host named in `db_host` in `data/config.json`.

## Authentication

All routes except `/health` require a bearer token:

```sh
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $(cat data/api_token)" \
     'http://127.0.0.1:8787/api/issues?overdue=1'
```

The token is generated at `tam init` with mode 600. There is one shared token: it carries no per-caller identity and cannot be revoked individually.

## Response envelope

```json
{"ok": true,  "data": {...}, "meta": {"count": 3}}
{"ok": false, "error": {"code": "not_found", "message": "..."}}
```

## Error codes

| code | HTTP | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `validation` | 400 | ValidationError |
| `unauthorized` | 401 | AuthError |
| `not_found` | 404 | NotFoundError |
| `conflict` | 409 | ConflictError |
| `transition_denied` | 409 | TransitionError |

## Issues

| method | path | auth | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/issues` | yes | Search and filter issues. Closed excluded unless asked for. |
| `POST` | `/api/issues` | yes | Create an issue. Body: title (required) plus any issue field. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/issues/{key}` | yes | Delete an issue. Its audit history survives. |
| `GET` | `/api/issues/{key}` | yes | One issue with subtasks, links and allowed next statuses. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/issues/{key}` | yes | Update issue fields. Status is rejected here - use /transition. |

## Filters

`GET /api/issues` accepts the same filter names as the CLI flags. Multi-valued filters take a comma-separated list or repeated parameters.

- **multi-valued**: `status`, `priority`, `type`, `labels`
- **text**: `project`, `assignee`, `text`, `parent`, `sort`, `order`, `updated_before`, `created_after`
- **dates**: `due_before`, `due_after`, `due_on`
- **booleans**: `overdue`, `is_blocked`, `include_closed`
- **integers**: `limit`, `offset`, `stale_days`

Unknown filter names are rejected with `400 validation`.

## Served outside the JSON API

| method | path | auth | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/` | no | The board UI (HTML). The token is injected into the page; no CORS headers are sent. |
| `GET` | `/docs` | yes | List the agent-facing documents (`docs/*.md`). |
| `GET` | `/docs/{name}.md` | yes | One document, as `text/markdown`. Nodes read their instructions from the host that enforces them rather than from a copy on shared storage. |

## Notes

- Status changes go through `POST /api/issues/{key}/transition`, never `PATCH`. The workflow matrix and its guards are enforced server-side and cannot be bypassed by any client.

- Write endpoints accept an `actor` field; it is recorded in the audit log. Give each agent its own actor name.

- `GET /api/events?since=<iso>` is a change feed built on the audit log — cheaper for an agent to poll than re-reading the board.

- There is no optimistic concurrency: simultaneous writes to one issue are serialised, but the later one wins silently. Agents are expected to work on disjoint issues.
